prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1187; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim file.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in Houston, making a left turn at an intersection with a green light. I'd been waiting a while for oncoming traffic to clear.
Q: What happened as you turned?
A: A vehicle coming straight through the intersection hit the rear passenger side of my car. I didn't see it until just before impact.
Q: Did you apply your brakes before the impact?
A: I think I braked a little, but there wasn't much time.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: No, I didn't hit my head. My knee struck the dashboard, though, and it's been painful since.
Q: Which knee, and what treatment have you received so far?
A: My right knee. I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and they took X-rays. I've been referred to an orthopedic specialist, and I have a follow-up scheduled.
Q: Have you had any prior injuries or treatment to that knee?
A: No, nothing before this.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've missed some work because I can't stand for long periods, and I'd like the claim to reflect that.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up once we review your medical records.
A: Okay, thank you.
